source: RBI Bulletin — Union Budget 2026-27: An Assessment, interest payments to revenue receipts ratio, published 2026-02-20; underlying figures from Budget at a Glance 2026-27.
notes: 39.7% of Union Government revenue receipts are budgeted for interest payments in 2026-27, up from 38.1% in the 2025-26 revised estimates. These are budget/revised estimates, not final actuals. This is a fiscal interest-burden ratio, not RBI's external debt-service ratio. No official latest-actual interest/revenue ratio was available, so no value is substituted.
